claims.summary: For every d>=6 in characteristic5, D=16d-41,N=8D+8, the full saturated dimension-eight elliptic source has conic boundary (r3+r2+s3+rs3)A_D normally, and (r5+r3s3)A_D+(r2+s3)B_D when d1mod5, with independent character coordinates,r2=1-t,s2=1+bt,g=r2s4. All25 A profiles and all five exceptional B profiles are explicit; B=F_(2D+1) except D15mod25, where the displayed three coupled outliers remain. Both spaces have dimension2D+2. Complete marked criteria have size at most17 and retain actual C=u^N,X,Y while all local coefficients depend only on dmod25.

Degrees2-5, primes>=7, higher dimensions and pre-stable thresholds are outside this theorem.

The complete-source transfer and scalar extension give every characteristic-five field.
